sources.title: 在 Anthropic 宣稱以 Claude 證明黎曼猜想的數小時後，史丹佛大學發布了一份全由人類完成的競爭草案 / Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.title_zh: 在 Anthropic 宣稱以 Claude 證明黎曼猜想的數小時後，史丹佛大學發布了一份全由人類完成的競爭草案
sources.title_en: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.title_original: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 數學家勒文特·阿爾波格（Levent Alpöge）表示，他利用 Claude 證明瞭黎曼猜想（數學界最著名且懸決 167 年的未解問題），該證明已在 Lean 中形式化，篇幅超過 25,000 頁。僅僅數小時後，史丹佛大學的研究人員發表了一份獨立且完全由人類完成的競爭證明，數學家們目前正在檢驗這兩者是否站得住腳。
